title: Highest individual ODI score
content: Rohit Sharma scored 264 runs against Sri Lanka at Eden Gardens in Kolkata on 13 November 2014. It remains the highest individual score in men's ODI cricket.
source: ESPNcricinfo scorecard: India vs Sri Lanka, Kolkata, 13 November 2014

title: Highest individual Test score
content: Brian Lara scored an unbeaten 400 for the West Indies against England in Antigua in April 2004. It is the highest individual score in men's Test cricket.
source: ESPNcricinfo scorecard: West Indies vs England, Antigua, April 2004

title: India wins the inaugural Men's T20 World Cup
content: India won the inaugural ICC Men's T20 World Cup in 2007, defeating Pakistan in the final in Johannesburg.
source: ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2007 final

title: 2019 Men's Cricket World Cup final
content: England and New Zealand tied both their 50-over final and the Super Over at Lord's in 2019. England were declared champions under the boundary-count rule then in force. The ICC subsequently removed that boundary-count tiebreaker.
source: ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2019 final

title: Sachin Tendulkar's international centuries
content: Sachin Tendulkar scored 100 international centuries: 51 in Test cricket and 49 in ODI cricket.

title: First men's T20 International
content: The first men's T20 International was played between Australia and New Zealand in February 2005.
source: ESPNcricinfo match archive: Australia vs New Zealand, February 2005

title: India wins the 1983 World Cup
content: India defeated the West Indies in the 1983 Men's Cricket World Cup final at Lord's, winning by 43 runs.
source: ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 1983 final

title: First men's ODI double century
content: Sachin Tendulkar became the first batter to score a double century in men's ODI cricket, scoring 200 not out against South Africa in Gwalior in February 2010.
source: ESPNcricinfo scorecard: India vs South Africa, Gwalior, 24 February 2010
